methodologyNotes: Covers stationary vertical band saws for a home or pro wood shop — benchtop models and floor-standing (cabinet or open-stand) 9- to 15-inch machines — sold at a published US price. Excludes handheld/portable 'portaband' cordless band saws, horizontal metal-cutting stock saws, scroll saws, and industrial resaw mills. Price is current US MSRP / typical retail in USD for the bare machine on its standard stand (blades and riser kits excluded unless factory-included). saw_type is 'benchtop' or 'floor-standing'. throat_capacity_in is the horizontal distance from the blade to the frame (the nominal saw size) in inches. resaw_capacity_in is the maximum cut height under the raised upper blade guides in inches; optional riser blocks are excluded unless included in the box. motor_hp is rated motor horsepower; null when the manufacturer rates the motor only in amps. blade_length_in is the nominal blade loop length in inches. blade_width_range_in is the minimum-to-maximum blade width the saw accepts, in fractional inches. blade_speed_fpm is blade surface speed in feet per minute, slash-separated for two- or multi-speed machines. table_size_in is the work-table width x depth in inches. table_tilt_deg is the table bevel range in degrees (right tilt, plus left tilt where supported). weight_lb is machine weight in pounds. accessedAt 2026-07-13.
